releases.name: Soda Shelf 2026-11-27
releases.body: Created Soda Shelf, an isometric pixel game about stocking a soda kiosk. The first build has one kiosk, one shelf, and twenty sodas. Customers walk up and buy, cash builds in the till, and an upgrades panel is ready.

jobs.description: Isometric pixel game where you stock a soda kiosk shelf and sell to customers.

releases.name: What Are You 2026-11-27
releases.body: Created What Are You, a collection of ten question quizzes that tell you which thing you are. Added result cards, a wall of your results, an image prompt for each result, and twelve new quizzes. Added the Big Test, a 50 question personality test that fills in all 24 quiz results, and a Match Me view that uses it.

jobs.description: A collection of 24 short quizzes that tell you which cheese, or what else, you are.

releases.name: Lumbricus 2026-11-27
releases.body: Created Lumbricus, a burrowing game where you play a worm digging through soil. Version 2 doubled the size of the world and added relics and a day and night cycle. Version 3 added a choice of worm species and ground, a burrow network, tunnel art to dig for bonus points, loops that pay a pocket bonus, more relics, and sound.

jobs.description: A burrowing game where you play a worm digging through soil, relics, and danger.

releases.name: Family Tree 2026-11-27
releases.body: Created Family Tree, a year by year page with money, income per year, a home, and a family tree. Version 2 added careers, skill fields, lineage, synergies, alignment, hobbies, and disability. Version 3 added over a hundred careers, western jobs, kid jobs, hobby tiers, work modes, windfalls, and business roles.

jobs.description: A year by year family and career simulation with money, skills, and a growing tree.

releases.name: Parallax Wire 2026-11-27
releases.body: Created Parallax Wire, a page that turns photos from several phones into refined images and 3D wireframes. Added a phone rig where each phone joins and takes the next free frame corner, with synced capture, and a relay server so phones on cellular data can link up. Repeated captures now stack into one depth model. Added object cutout, which keeps only the object in the mesh, and a built in feature matcher that replaced a heavier image library, plus a timeout on the object finder.

jobs.description: Turns multi phone parallax photos and 3D captures into refined images and wireframes.

releases.name: Rocketbench 2026-11-27
releases.body: Version 2 added a round planet with orbits, a thermal model, drogue and main parachutes, and rocket tiers with a hangar. The orbit map now shows live known satellite orbits (ISS, Tiangong, Hubble, GPS, geostationary) with a nearest satellite readout. Added Match the ISS and Hubble Shell missions, and a Pajamastan Space Administration link with a live space weather GO or HOLD badge.

jobs.description: Rocket flight simulator with part stacking, staging, and missions.

releases.name: Ghost Wing 2026-11-27
releases.body: Replaced the tile game that landed here by mistake with Ghost Wing, an aircraft game. Version 2 added a hangar menu, five aircraft, loadouts, and runway takeoff and landing. Version 3 added a door gunner, a SAM battery, attack drones, FPV quads, defense missions, and wingman and strike drones.

jobs.description: Aircraft game with a hangar, five aircraft, loadouts, and drone defense missions.

releases.name: Hopper 2026-11-27
releases.body: Version 7 added Up Mode, with vertical towers, left and right steering, and bounce ledges that work on their own. Version 8 added floor levels where a tower top becomes the new floor, cliff drops with gliders, and air traffic during flight stretches.

jobs.description: Endless side scrolling hopper with slopes, boulders, gliders, and flight stretches.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-27
releases.body: Added a ticket clock that logs time on site on the ticket and syncs it. Added a work clock, so every locker visit logs itself with no ticket needed.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-25
releases.body: Added shared Hub View library tables and a worker schedule. The Hub View worker now runs only when its queue holds jobs.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-23
releases.body: The route view now follows you up close, the floating window stays on you, and the Sites tab is now called Site survey. The phone app can rotate, dim the screen, and stay awake for the dash cam. Hire Portal got shared tables, admins who join with an owner code, and a cleanup for test applications.

jobs.description: A field log with a map, receipts, mileage, and an Android app that tracks stops.

releases.name: ClipRig 2026-11-25
releases.body: Added themes with intro animations and a live preview tab, and a rapid fire montage mode. Added a live camera source, any video in the inbox, a fast forward recap style, highlight speed, and rapid fire that fills short footage with fast forward replays. Added a music tab with a song queue, previews, a song start point, and a new music button on clips. The advertised link is now separate from the play address, with an intro line, pop up lines dropped into clips, and a default text editor. The top bar has an update button, and the app checks for updates whenever you return to it.

jobs.description: Android app that records your screen, finds highlights, and edits clips.

releases.name: Manual Rebuild 2026-11-25
releases.body: Added a book mode with page turning, two page spreads, pinch zoom, wear that builds with use, glare that follows tilt, bookmarks, notes, search, and added photo pages. Added a library of books where you can combine two books page by page or in sequence, pull picked pages from another book, compare side by side, and save and load whole books. Version 4 then lets you drag a figure up off a page into a 3D wireframe.

jobs.description: Traces manual figures into parts and shows them in an exploded 3D view.

releases.name: Ascend 2026-11-25
releases.body: Fixed a cloud kingdom crash and made the game loop crash proof. Added northern lights and emerald night zones, and career result screens with a time board for each level. Marathon mode is now an endless sideways run on climb physics, where the abyss drops you from the sky, and it has its own leaderboard. Version 2.0 added fuel mode, where gems are fuel and every gem in a stretch levels you up at the gate, and the side scroll engine gained all the climb power-ups.

jobs.description: Vertical platformer with endless platforms, many modes, and global leaderboards.
